svg.title: Brand graphic language
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Four supporting elements, used sparingly: an ornamental border drawn
from Mughal inlay, a geometric cube texture, momentum bands and an
Agra business skyline that grounds every page footer.
Ornamental border · section dividers, print edges, badge footers
Cube texture · quiet backgrounds for light sections
Momentum bands · price tags, invitations, ad corners
Agra business skyline · Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, industry and logistics in one line — site footer and print base
IN USE ON THE LANDING PAGE
